+def _is_acronym(word: str) -> bool:
+    """
+    Return True if the word has two or more letters and they are all
+    capitals, like "NASA" or "MP3".
+    """
+    return word.isupper() and sum(char.isupper() for char in word) > 1
+
+
+def _titleize_word(word: str) -> str:
+    """
+    Capitalize a single word for :func:`titleize`, keeping it as it is when it
+    is written in all capitals.
+    """
+    if _is_acronym(word):
+        return word
+    title = re.sub(
+        r"\b('?\w)",
+        lambda match: match.group(1).capitalize(),
+        word.lower().title()
+    )
+    # In a word like "NASA's", keep the acronym and capitalize the rest.
+    return "'".join(
+        part if _is_acronym(part) else title_part
+        for part, title_part in zip(word.split("'"), title.split("'"))
+    )
+
+

+def _separate_words(word: str) -> str:

+    Separate the words of a CamelCase or dasherized string with underscores,
